notes.title: FULLSCREEN, SCALING, FILTER, ETC
notes.content:
Hi all!

Due to some wonderings (and some negative reviews ːsteamsadː ) from new players, here is a small statement:

[i]If you go to your SteamApps\common\Dustbowl and open "winsetup" there you can change pixel filter options, additional sound options and Full Screen mode.[/i]

Sorry about this, I know it's not obvious, but it's related to the engine we used.

I do hope that helps :)

HF!

notes.title: 1.4.3 Patch!
notes.content:
Hi wastelanders

The recent 1.4.3 patch has fixed a number of reported issues which should make the whole experience much better. 

Specific fixes include...

[*] Fixed armour giving the player radiation.
[*] Displays the correct armour when using the power glove weapon.
[*] Fixed some dialogue issues with the Controller quest.
[*] Fixed some issues moving from different maps - involved the player getting stuck.
[*] Issues with selling equipped items fixed.

Note: older save should work fine but there maybe a few issues with these carried over saves and the 1.4.3 patch.

That's all for now. If any other bugs are found please report them in our 'Bugs' section the Discussions group.

Please drink responsibly.

notes.title: Delay In Release
notes.content:
Our plan was to release at 7PM PDT and the game is all ready to go. However, due to an unforeseen issue with STEAMWORKS and their closing times for 'Release Options"; release will now have to be postponed until Monday.

We deeply regret, this but look forward to releasing Dustbowl at the earliest convenience.
